summary: Week Apr 28–May 1: Mag 7 Superweek — MSFT/META/AMZN/GOOG report Wed, AAPL Thu. FOMC holds at 3.50-3.75% (99.7%). NFP Friday. Intel +24% historic day. Gold $4,741. VIX 18.71 risk-on. Semis +13% top industry.

risks.label: Mag 7 Earnings Miss — $15T on Trial
risks.detail: 4 of 5 Mag 7 report Wednesday after hours (MSFT, META, AMZN, GOOG). AAPL Thursday. If 2+ miss or guide down on AI capex ROI, S&P could drop 3-5% in a single session. AMZN at 52-week high = priced for perfection.

risks.label: FOMC Hawkish Surprise (Apr 28-29)
risks.detail: Hold priced at 99.7% but Powell presser tone matters. 3.3% CPI and 2.8% core PCE = no room for cuts. 7 FOMC members project zero cuts in 2026. Any hawkish shift = 2% equity selloff + 10Y above 4.5%.

risks.label: Iran Escalation / Oil Spike
risks.detail: Brent at $99 pricing Strait of Hormuz risk. Direct confrontation could push oil above $120/bbl, reigniting inflation and forcing Fed hawkish. Tanker insurance up 40% since January.

risks.label: NFP Surprise (Fri May 1)
risks.detail: Non-Farm Payrolls HIGH impact. Hot print (>250K) spikes yields. Cold (<100K) triggers recession fears. Sweet spot 150-200K. Final event risk of the week.

risks.label: Semiconductor Bubble Formation
risks.detail: INTC +24% (best day since 1987), AMD +14%, ARM +15% in one week. INTC at 59x fwd PE, up 100% YTD. Speed of repricing leaves zero margin for error. Any AI capex guidance disappointment = 10-15% semis correction.

events.label: FOMC Rate Decision (Wed Apr 29)
events.detail: Two-day meeting Tue-Wed. Expected hold 3.50-3.75%. Powell presser 2:30pm ET Wed. Statement language on rate path is the market-moving variable.

events.label: Mag 7 Earnings Superday (Wed Apr 29)
events.detail: MSFT ($4.07 EPS), META ($6.65), AMZN ($1.63), GOOG ($2.64) all report after hours. Combined mcap $15.8T. The most consequential earnings day of Q1 season.

events.label: AAPL Earnings (Thu Apr 30)
events.detail: Apple reports Q1: $1.93 EPS, $108.9B revenue. iPhone demand in China, Services growth, Apple Intelligence AI features. Anchor of Thursday trading.

events.label: Non-Farm Payrolls (Fri May 1)
events.detail: BLS employment report 8:30am ET. Final verdict on the week. Goldilocks range: 150-200K. Hot/cold both disruptive.

events.label: Pershing Square IPO (Wed Apr 29)
events.detail: Bill Ackman's PS lists on NYSE at $50. Could draw significant capital from secondary markets if oversubscribed.

opportunities.label: GOOG — Earnings Catalyst + AI Search
opportunities.detail: Fresh BUY signal Apr 24 at $339. Cheapest mega-cap at 25x fwd PE. 2% below 52w high. Cloud + Gemini AI monetization. Entry $338-345, TP $355-375.

opportunities.label: NEM — Gold Supercycle Play
opportunities.detail: Gold $4,741 near ATH. Newmont BUY signal Apr 24. 11x fwd PE absurdly cheap. DXY weakness + geopolitical hedge. Entry $118-122, TP $130-140.

opportunities.label: AMZN — 52W High Breakout
opportunities.detail: At 52-week high $264.50. AWS accelerating, retail margins expanding. BUY since Mar 31. Entry $260-265, TP $280-300. Aggressive — half-size recommended pre-earnings.

opportunities.label: Gold & Silver Structural Bull
opportunities.detail: Gold $4,741, Silver $76.41. Central bank buying 1000+ tonnes/yr. DXY 98.51 weakening. Institutional targets $4,800-5,200. GLD/SLV for passive exposure.

opportunities.label: XLK Technology Momentum
opportunities.detail: Tech sector +2.81% week, far outpacing all others. Semis +13% best industry. AI hardware trade broadening beyond NVDA to INTC/AMD/ARM.

regime_blips.label: RISK-ON Regime (Score 0.42)
regime_blips.detail: VIX 18.71. SPX above 50-DMA. Credit stable (HYG +0.14%). Risk-on composite confirmed. Position sizing 1.0x but with cash buffer (7%) for event risk.

regime_blips.label: DXY Weakness — 98.51
regime_blips.detail: Dollar index continues decline from 104+ in January. Supports gold, commodities, international equities, and multinational revenues. EUR/USD 1.1726.

regime_blips.label: Inflation Moderate but Sticky
regime_blips.detail: CPI 3.3% YoY, core PCE 2.8%. TIP stable. Inflation trend: stable. Fed boxed in — can't cut, won't hike. Higher-for-longer confirmed.

regime_blips.label: Sentiment Slightly Bullish
regime_blips.detail: 7 bullish, 1 bearish, 12 neutral articles (FT + Yahoo). Positive but not euphoric. Polymarket: 25.5% recession odds, 39.3% zero cuts in 2026.
